approach: Fault: StateDir::clean_job (state.rs:113) discards the removal error and measures nothing. Make it return CleanReport {bytes, error: Option<(PathBuf,String)>}. Bytes are the job directory's allocated size (st_blocks*512, each (dev,ino) once, symlink_metadata, no symlink following), measured just before removal. StateDir gains a fn-pointer remover field (default pin::remove_tree) with a public with_remover(fn(&Path)->io::Result<()>) seam, so a test can inject a failure after the job lock is taken and the commit is done. A helper report_clean(&dyn Ui,&CleanReport) in state.rs prints 'reclaimed 11.4 GB' on success. On error it prints only 'warning: could not remove <path>: <err>' and never a reclaimed line. Call it at manage.rs:135 and 224 and run.rs:2276, 2451 (non-blocked only) and 2568, each after the closing commit succeeds. Ui has only line(), so display.rs, pin.rs and athena.toml need no change. Shared target dir is recorded as not adopted.

decisions.choice: Keep per-job target dirs; delete the job dir on close and report bytes; record the shared-target question in decisions.md; athena.toml unchanged.
decisions.reason: Review 2 R14: a shared target dir executed another job's stale test binaries; per-job isolation (D46) is needed by the checks. Deleting on close removes the disk growth.

rejected.why: Stale binaries (R14), build-lock contention, out of scope.

decisions.choice: Report the allocated size of the whole job dir (what is actually freed), counting hard links once.
decisions.reason: The dir also holds snapshots, live/, usage/, job.lock; cargo hard-links artifacts; sparse files differ in length.

rejected.why: Double-counts hard links, overstates sparse files.
Under-describes freed space and adds a second measurement.

decisions.choice: Failure injection through a StateDir remover seam (fn pointer, pub with_remover) returning an injected io::Error; plus unit tests in state.rs with a regular file at the path where no lock is involved.
decisions.reason: A regular file at the job-dir path makes try_lock_job (manage.rs:94, state.rs:75 create_dir_all) fail before any commit, so the lifecycle test could never reach cleanup. The seam fails removal after lock and commit. A control step in the same test shows the default remover removes a normal dir.

rejected.option: Regular file at job-dir path in the lifecycle test
rejected.why: Close fails at the lock, before the commit.

rejected.option: chattr +i or mode bits on nested files
rejected.why: Root bypasses modes; chattr depends on filesystem and needs teardown.

decisions.choice: On removal success always print the reclaimed line, with no threshold. A job dir holding only job.lock reports its small exact allocated size (e.g. 'reclaimed 4.1 KB') and no warning. On error print only the warning.
decisions.reason: The dir is never missing or empty at close (the lock creates job.lock) and the dir inode itself has blocks, so a threshold would be arbitrary. A uniform line is simple, and a reclaimed line must never claim space that was not freed.

rejected.option: Print nothing for small or empty dirs
rejected.why: Case cannot arise through close; threshold is arbitrary.

rejected.option: Print reclaimed with the pre-measured bytes even on failure

decisions.choice: Removal failure only warns; the close stays Ok. Write format_bytes in state.rs (decimal, one decimal: B, KB, MB, GB, TB).
decisions.reason: Records are already committed, so failing would make the job look unclosed. No formatter exists, and a new crate is not worth a lockfile change.

rejected.option: Fail the close on removal error

rejected.why: Wider change; a ui line meets the criterion.

files.purpose: CleanReport, remover seam with with_remover, allocated-bytes walk with dedup, format_bytes, report_clean, unit tests.
Use clean_job and report_clean at lines 135 and 224 after the commit.
Per-path, removal-failure, no-cache and kept-dir tests; fix exact-output assertions.
Shared target directory decision with alternatives and R14 evidence.
Entry for build cache deletion and space reclaimed.
One-line note on deletion and reporting.

steps: In state.rs add the remover fn-pointer field (default pin::remove_tree) and with_remover. Make clean_job return CleanReport (walk with symlink_metadata, blocks()*512, (dev,ino) set, then remove; on error record the path and message). Add format_bytes and report_clean (success prints reclaimed; error prints only the warning). Unit tests: hand-computed hard-link tree, walk comparison, regular file at the path, format_bytes.
Replace the five call sites in manage.rs and run.rs with clean_job plus report_clean, each after its closing commit; keep the Blocked exception at run.rs:2451.
Add lifecycle.rs tests: each closing path, no-cache job (job.lock only), removal failure via injected remover with a control, and kept-dir cases (blocked, failed commit). Fix exact-output tests.
Write the decisions.md entry, CHANGELOG entry and README note; leave athena.toml, display.rs and pin.rs untouched.
Run cargo fmt --all, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: Block counts differ across filesystems, so exact tests could flake.
risks.mitigation: Compare to an independent walk, plant files of at least a block, and use a hand-computed value only in the state.rs unit test, with sizes from blocks() of the created files.

risks.risk: Existing tests assert exact closing output that the new line breaks.
The remover seam adds public surface only for tests.
risks.mitigation: Keep it a small documented fn-pointer field defaulting to pin::remove_tree.

risks.risk: A removal failure leaves a 12 GB dir.
risks.mitigation: The warning names the path; the close still succeeds.

risks.risk: Walking a 12 GB tree is slow.

demonstrations.method: state.rs unit tests: a dir with target/ files, job.lock, live/x, and a hard-linked pair. Assert the dir is gone and report.bytes equals a hand-computed value for a small tree (one file's blocks*512 once for the linked pair, plus each directory's blocks*512). Also compare to a test-local walk and check it is at least the planted target allocation. lifecycle.rs: one test per path (landed, failed, rejected, abandoned, interrupted then athena close, closed while blocked). Plant a multi-block target/ file before the closing commit (fake producer on go paths; pre-planted for close paths). Record an independent walk just before closing, then assert the dir is absent and the output has 'reclaimed ' plus format_bytes of that number.
demonstrations.observes: No job directory remains on any closing path and the reported figure matches the independent measurement.
demonstrations.fails_without: A path that skipped cleanup leaves the dir; without measurement no 'reclaimed' line appears.

demonstrations.method: format_bytes unit test (11_400_000_000 -> '11.4 GB', plus B/KB/MB/TB). Lifecycle tests capture the Lines ui output of go and close and assert a 'reclaimed <N> <unit>' line. A job whose dir holds only job.lock yields a 'reclaimed' line equal to format_bytes of its measured size and no line containing 'warning'.
demonstrations.observes: Human-unit reclaimed line appears; the no-cache job shows no failure.
demonstrations.fails_without: Missing helper means no line; a spurious warning would fail the no-warning assertion.

demonstrations.method: Lifecycle test with the injected remover returning an io::Error: close a job (lock taken, commit succeeds). Assert close returns Ok, a line starts with 'warning' and contains the job-dir path, and no line contains 'reclaimed'. A control in the same test uses the default remover on a normal dir and sees it removed with no error. state.rs unit tests put a regular file at the path and assert report.error carries the path and report_clean prints only the warning.
demonstrations.observes: Warning naming the path, no reclaimed claim, close Ok.
demonstrations.fails_without: With `let _ =` swallowing, no warning line and the assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Tests: a job left Blocked after go still has its dir and no reclaimed line. A close whose commit fails (gate violation or unwritable record) returns Err with the dir intact and no reclaimed line. An interrupted job's dir exists before athena close.
demonstrations.observes: Dir present and no reclaimed output in each case.
demonstrations.fails_without: Cleanup before or regardless of the commit would remove the dir.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff: a new decisions.md entry (next free number) on the shared target dir, with alternatives, R14 evidence from docs/design/reviews/athena-v0-review-2.md, and the decision not to share. athena.toml has no diff.
demonstrations.observes: Entry present with evidence and decision; athena.toml unchanged.

demonstrations.fails_without: Format, lint or test failures give nonzero exit.
